title: Futex caveat closure follow-up
summary: Pick up the remaining futex Linux-compat stabilization caveats by converting PI-condvar evidence into a judge-scored group, making LTP futex discovery runnable, and scoping the remaining SCHED_DEADLINE item as scheduler work rather than a futex merge blocker.

write_sets.notes: Continuation in codex/futex-linux-compat; target/oscomp images are generated evidence and not source artifacts.

steps.title: Make PI-condvar evidence judge-scored
steps.notes: The helper now injects pthread_pi_condvar_testcode.sh, selects tx.oscomp.groups=pthread-pi-condvar, copies a matching judge script into the private data dir, and asserts tools/oscomp-judge.py reports [pthread-pi-condvar] 1/1. The Makefile target now builds the RV64 kernel before copying it into the private submit dir.

steps.title: Make slim LTP futex discovery runnable
steps.notes: Fixed Python 3.9 compatibility, output parent creation, inode mode preservation, and LTP musl libc inclusion. The slim futex image reaches 17 futex/robust LTP cases. Most break on missing /proc/meminfo, while set_robust_list01 exits 0. fault-decode found no trap lines.

steps.title: Scope SCHED_DEADLINE caveat
steps.notes: Confirmed this is not a futex-specific semantic gap: scheduler docs still list Deadline as a Phase 3 EDF/admission-control class, while current futex PI priority donation uses RT PriorityKey ordering. The remaining action is a scheduler plan, not a futex merge blocker.

verification.notes: The new group maps to pthread_pi_condvar_testcode.sh.
Produced [pthread-pi-condvar] 1/1, guest userspace exit 0, and no fault-decode trap lines.
Listed the futex and robust LTP cluster from the canonical RV64 image.
The slim image boots and reaches all 17 selected cases; most return TBROK on missing /proc/meminfo, set_robust_list01 exits 0, userspace exits 0, and fault-decode finds no trap lines.

risks: LTP futex cases require procfs content such as /proc/meminfo before they can isolate futex semantics.
SCHED_DEADLINE requires EDF/admission-control scheduler work and should not be represented as complete by the futex PI model.
blockers: Broader LTP futex semantic pass is blocked by /proc/meminfo coverage, not by a decoded kernel trap.
